## What this is
- [ ] A learning from my installed copy's Sunday scout (file under `learnings/proposed/`, made with `scripts/learnings.py propose`)
- [ ] Data from my runs (`data/<handle>/`, made with `scripts/publish_data.py publish`)
- [ ] Something else (say what, and why it is not an issue first)

## Learning checklist
- [ ] Threshold met (4+ trades, 3 for bear funds) or the file says `status at source: idea`
- [ ] The mechanism names the rule that produced the outcome
- [ ] One specific change, one area, with expected cost and how to judge it
- [ ] No account identifiers, nothing that identifies a person
- [ ] `learnings/INDEX.md` regenerated (the script does this)

## Operator context that matters
Account scale band, vehicle mix, anything that could make this local to one account.
